frontendHandoff.body:
Backend source handoff for a separate frontend successor: [Meri PR42](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/pull/42), published source/evidence `69226d1d4223a333e2dc8bdc5b42363aa55c9b5b`. This does not change this frozen shipping head `7c87678730538958ace9762f824dc3e588bf445b`.

The recommendation → draft → immutable pending proposal → separately approved execution/replay flow is implemented and independently reviewed. **124/124 integrated checks pass**, plus actual loopback HTTP CLI; one task effect, identical replay, listener closed/zero sockets. Run `node scripts/local-followthrough/http-run.mjs --run` with the existing pinned Node24 dependencies. This is bounded synthetic local evidence, not a deployed backend or native database/provider qualification.

[API and trusted-session contract](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/69226d1d4223a333e2dc8bdc5b42363aa55c9b5b/apps/control/action-application/README.md), [actual Fetch wire examples](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/69226d1d4223a333e2dc8bdc5b42363aa55c9b5b/docs/qualification/candidates/action-wiring-20261013/integration/wire-fixtures.json), [HTTP mount/ownership](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/69226d1d4223a333e2dc8bdc5b42363aa55c9b5b/docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-ACTION-WIRING-HTTP-20261013.md), and [full handoff](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/69226d1d4223a333e2dc8bdc5b42363aa55c9b5b/docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-ACTION-WIRING-20261013.md) are frozen at that source.

The new POST routes are `/api/action-followthrough/query` with `{request}`, `/draft` with `{selection,edits?}`, `/prepare` with `{draft}`, and `/execute` with `{proposal}`. Use a separate authenticated JSON adapter alongside the existing AI SDK stream consumer; preserve canonical UIEvent validation/projection. Opaque session authority, current tenant/client/scopes and execution authorization stay server-owned. No approval HTTP route exists; the fixture approval method is not browser authority. Pending proposals must remain visibly pending, and uncertain/known-stored error outcomes must not trigger automatic retry.

Please wire selection/edit/pending presentation in a successor branch after agreeing the action-result validation boundary; preserve current public0.1 exports and do not import private backend modules into the browser. Qualified host bindings and frontend browser verification remain separate work.

changesAfterTestedSource: Documentation/evidence/publication receipt only; accepted runnable bytes unchanged.
scope: Source-only draft; no merge, production activation, customer data, paid calls, native publication or infrastructure actions.
